description: Find certified US skilled nursing facilities near an address or in a city. Filter by ownership type, star rating, abuse flag, high-performing icon, or Special Focus status. Returns ownership, ratings, nurse hours (HPRD), nurse/RN turnover, weighted inspection score, beds, fines, straight-line distance_miles, and map links. distance_miles is straight-line miles, not drive time. An address is geocoded on the server.

abuse_icon.description: CMS abuse icon filter. Y/yes/true/1 keeps only flagged homes; other values keep homes without the flag.

address.description: Street address with city and state, or a street and ZIP. Geocoded by the Census Bureau as the distance origin. A city, place name, or ZIP alone will not match.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

icon_hi_perf.description: CMS high-performing icon (Risk-Based Survey eligibility). Y/yes/true/1 keeps only homes with the icon; other values keep homes without it. Point-in-time, not a permanent award.

ownership.description: Ownership type from ProviderInfo.ownership. Case-insensitive. Prefixes For profit, Non profit, and Government match that kind. Exact labels look like "For profit - Limited Liability company".

sffstatus.description: When truthy, keep only Special Focus Facility or candidate homes (non-empty sffstatus).

sort.description: Sort key: overall_rating (default, desc), survey_rating, quality_rating, staffing_rating, distance (asc, straight-line miles), tothrd or total_nurse_hours (desc), totalnursingstaffturnover or nurse_turnover (asc), weighted_all_cycles_score or survey_score (asc). Unknown values fall back to overall_rating.
